The complete model

These example weights are chosen by hand. Every displayed value is calculated from this same model at each time step.

Input encoding

xₜ ∈ ℝ⁴, ordered [RED, BLUE, blank, ASK]. RED = [1,0,0,0]; BLUE = [0,1,0,0]; blank = [0,0,1,0]; ASK = [0,0,0,1].

Shared parameters

ComponentW (1 × 4)Ub
Forget f[−3, −3, 4, 4]0.50
Input i[3, 3, −4, −4]−0.50
Candidate g[1.5, −1.5, 0, 0]00
Output o[−3, −3, −3, 3]0.50

Notation

cₜ: internal memory. hₜ: exposed hidden state. fₜ, iₜ, oₜ: gates in (0,1). gₜ = c̃ₜ: candidate memory in (−1,1). All are scalars in this one-unit model. ⊙ means elementwise multiplication; here it is ordinary multiplication.

zₐ = Wₐxₜ + Uₐhₜ₋₁ + bₐ
fₜ = σ(zf) · iₜ = σ(zᵢ) · oₜ = σ(zₒ)
gₜ = tanh(zg)
cₜ = fₜ ⊙ cₜ₋₁ + iₜ ⊙ gₜ
hₜ = oₜ ⊙ tanh(cₜ)

σ(z) = 1/(1 + e⁻ᶻ). tanh(z) = (eᶻ − e⁻ᶻ)/(eᶻ + e⁻ᶻ). Initial states c₀ = h₀ = 0.

Readout

At ASK only: logits [ℓRED, ℓBLUE] = [4h₄, −4h₄]. Softmax converts these into two probabilities. The larger probability is the answer.

Arithmetic uses full precision; labels are rounded to four decimals. Memory decays slightly through blanks because the forget gate is near 1, rather than exactly 1. Intermediate hidden states are not predictions.
